use_case: Use the request form during residential electrical service call dispatch when the electrical call record must identify panel, breaker, circuit, device, symptom, affected loads, occupancy, access, and prior modifications. Complete the applicable handoff for safe re-energization, label correction, customer explanation, permit status, repair warranty, and service record.
